q1.explanationZh: 这句问“你是否理解理想生活是什么意思”，understand（理解）最合适。

evidence.quote: Have you ever asked yourself what your ideal life would be like?

q2.explanationZh: 后面是作者自己对理想生活的看法，所以用 In my opinion（在我看来）。

evidence.quote: to live an ideal life means to do something you are interested in

q3.explanationZh: 后一句说要努力工作，说明做自己感兴趣的事并不总是“容易”的。

evidence.quote: you need to work hard now

q4.explanationZh: 农民春夏秋努力干活，是为了冬天能舒舒服服地过，所以选 comfortably。

evidence.quote: he must work hard during spring, summer and autumn

q5.explanationZh: 理想生活属于未来，是作者“想象”出来的，选 imagined。

evidence.quote: ideal lives and I would like to share them with you

q6.explanationZh: 在编程比赛里得到的应该是“奖项”，选 prizes。

q7.explanationZh: 作者希望理想生活将来能“实现”，come true 就是实现。

evidence.quote: I hope this will help me make my ideal life

q8.explanationZh: 熊猫是中国的国宝，national treasure 是固定说法。

evidence.quote: The panda is considered a national

q9.explanationZh: 前半句“科学家了解很多”和后半句“仍然值得研究”意思相反，用 Although（尽管）。

evidence.quote: scientists know much about them, I still think it is worth studying them.

q10.explanationZh: 要实现理想就要一直“专注于”目标，stay focused on 是“保持专注”。

evidence.quote: achieving your ideal life, you might actually get there.
